text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Listen up! This is a super top secret, but... there's an amazing kind of training called "Sand Training"!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
If you build a super gigantic sandcastle at the beach,
your body and mind will get super-duper strong!!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: I read about this in a ninja manga!! You should definitely read it too, Trainer!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And carried away by her passionate speech,
we ended up coming to the ocean.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
All riiiight! I'll do my best to build it!
A super-duper huge sandcastleee!!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Look forward to it, Trainer!
Training on the dirt is guaranteed to make me stronger!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Even the main character split a rock that wouldn't break before!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Regardless of whether it was true, I thought it would be a nice break
and decided to keep them company until they were satisfied.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Huff, puff, whew...! Sand is way heavier than I thought it'd be!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
The sand is so loose it's hard to walk on!
It's working! Just like in the manga!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
All riiiight, let's keep churning them out!
Trainer! Let's do our best!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Because you wanna get
stronger too, right, Trainer!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Before long, their efforts bore fruit, and quite a large sandcastle was completed.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Amazing!! But I want to make it even more amazing!!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Hey, hey, what do we do!? Trainer!!!
choice_data_list: Let's make it an even bigger castle!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Sounds great!
Let's make it the flashiest castle in the whole world!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
What should I do? I want to make
an awesome castle with all sorts of stuff attached to it~!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I'm getting so excited!
I'm gonna go gather a whole bunch of seashells!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With the shells and coral they collected,
the castle grew more and more decorated.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Look, look, Trainer!
This castle looks super strong!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The "sand training" continued in full force
until the sun went down.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —A few days later.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
You know what! I did "sand training"!
And then I made a super strong sandcastle!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Huh, what do you mean?
Did you train to make the castle stronger~?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Yeah!!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As a result of the "sand training,"
before anyone realized it, it seemed the sandcastle
had grown stronger rather than her.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
You're right!
The one in the manga was way bigger!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I gotta haul way more sand
and make it shockingly huge!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: All riiiight, I'm gonna bring over a looooot of sand!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Wah! It's so big!
Ehehe! We did it, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Before long, a huge, magnificent sandcastle was built, and satisfied, she brought her training to a close.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —A few days later.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer!
Do you know what 'waterfall training' is?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: After that, I went to the river with her full of motivation, and through one thing or another, we felt thoroughly refreshed.
